name: Public Review of Canada's International Assistance Policy
content:
Note: the following entry is a stub. Please help us complete it.Problems and Purpose 
  On May 18, 2016 the Honourable Marie-Claude Bibeau, Minister of International Development and La Francophonie announced a public review and consultations to renew Canada’s international assistance policy and funding framework. The consultation involved participants from over 65 countries over a 6-month period.
